title: 0 Of 7 Brain Networks Supported The Left-Brain Myth
hook: 0 of 7 brain networks supported the personality myth.
closing: Your brain works as one team, so a left-or-right label cannot define you.
question: Were you given a brain label?

segments.say: Language leans left in 96 percent of right-handers. Personality does not, so one real specialization cannot prove the myth.
All 7 brain networks worked across both sides. The personality myth failed its direct test.
About 200 million nerve fibers connect the brain's halves. Constant signal sharing means neither side runs you alone.
